subject: Observability go-live safety net + alert sculpting
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearbridge.com>, Nate Su <nate@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability go-live safety net + alert sculpting

Hi Elena / Nate —

Congrats on locking the deployment window for next Tuesday. Before we flip traffic, the CS and ops team put together a short "go-live safety net" so you have clear acceptance criteria and we avoid noisy alerts in the first 48 hours. High-level ask: please confirm the owners below and any must-have constraints by EOD Friday.

Acceptance checklist (short):
- Dashboards: 3 live dashboards (Inbound API, Token consumption / cost, Error breakdown) with baseline metrics and a glossary. Owner: Marissa.
- Tracing hooks: top-level request span + downstream service spans for inference path (tokenize -> runtime -> postprocess). Ensure span names match our trace-map (I attached a proposed mapping). Owner: ClearBridge engineering + Redwood instrumentation review.
- Error taxonomy: map errors to severity (info/warning/critical) and specify which map to page SRE vs append to customer ticket queue. We propose auto-suppress low-volume parser warnings.
- Alert routing: route P0/P1 to ClearBridge oncall and Redwood SRE; P2->ticket queue; mute policy for first 48 hours with canary threshold triggers. Owner: Ben.
- Runbooks: one verified runbook for the most common failure modes (high-latency, out-of-memory, corrupted payloads). We'll run a tabletop with your oncall pre-go-live. Owner: Priya.

Attachments included: safety-net-checklist.xlsx, alert-routing-diagram.png
Links: runbook stub https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/clearbridge

Next steps we suggest:
1) Quick sync on Thursday (30m) to finalize alert thresholds.
2) Pre-go-live tabletop Friday with your oncall.
3) Keep alerts muted except for P0/P1 until Monday 11:59 PDT (we auto-unmute unless you request extended mute).

If you want, I can send a one-pager that maps each alert to an owner and the initial threshold we recommend.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: safety-net-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB)]
[Attachment: alert-routing-diagram.png (image, 58KB)]

From: Elena Park <elena@clearbridge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability go-live safety net + alert sculpting

Thanks Priya — this looks helpful. A few constraints from our side:

- We definitely need the 48-hour mute for non-critical alerts. We can't have a flood of P2/P3s waking folks up during initial traffic shaping.
- Can we limit the volume of sampled traces? Our budget for storage is limited; we can start at 10% sampling for production and increase if needed.
- For dashboards: please avoid sending personally identifiable logs to our dashboards. Our security folks (cc'd below) will need to review the trace span payload examples before anything is ingested.

Also: small ask on the runbook tabletop — can you slot our security lead (security@clearbridge.com) into the Friday session? They'll want to validate retention and KMS usage.

If you can confirm owners and the suggested mute/unmute schedule, we'll lock the deployment.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Dir. Platform Engineering, ClearBridge Health

On Tue, May 19, 2026 at 9:12 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Congrats on locking the deployment window for next Tuesday...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearbridge.com>, Nate Su <nate@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability go-live safety net + alert sculpting

Elena — great callouts. Short answers and owners (so we can move to action):

- 48-hour mute: agreed. We'll publish a canary-based rule set: initial thresholds are 3x baseline for latency P1, and error-rate P0 at 0.5% of requests. Only P0/P1 will page. Ben will own the routing and canary config.
- Trace sampling: we'll start at 10% as requested. Marissa and I will share an example of redacted spans; Redwood will run the ingestion in a staging project and provide a sanitized sample for your security review.
- Dashboard data: all dashboards will point to aggregated metrics; no raw payloads. We'll add a glossary and a line item in the runbook documenting allowed payload fields.

Action items:
1) Marissa: produce the sanitized trace sample and dashboards export by Thursday 5/21 EOD.
2) Priya: schedule Friday tabletop with ClearBridge oncall + security (please include conference bridge and agenda).
3) Ben: implement initial canary rules in the staging org and share the alert-routing diagram (will attach).

I'll open a short-lived ticket in HubSpot and post the links.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior CS Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: alert-routing-diagram.png (image, 58KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@clearbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability go-live safety net + alert sculpting

Elena / team — confirming the plan and next artifacts.

I've attached the first draft of the runbook (runbook-v0.2.md) and a sanitized trace sample (sanitized-trace-sample.txt) — the sample has span names and latency buckets only, no payloads.

Short checklist for the Friday tabletop:
- 10m intro and goals
- 15m tracing sample review and payload redaction confirmation (security)
- 15m alert routing and oncall responsibilities (ClearBridge oncall + Redwood SRE)
- 10m runbook walk-through and escalation flow
- 10m wrap / next steps

If that agenda looks good I'll send a calendar invite for 30m and include dial-in + MTR link.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-v0.2.md (markdown, 9KB)]
